pre_registration_note: Acceptance criteria, universe, weights, rebalance rule, window length and datasets were fixed in this file BEFORE scripts/research/passive_core_eval.py was run on real data. Any change to this file changes spec_hash and voids prior results.
prior_knowledge_disclosure: Not a blind test: data/core_satellite_backtest_5y.json (2026-06-18) already evaluated this same 8-ETF basket on overlapping 5y data. The basket was not fitted (no tunable parameters), but its selection was informed by that study, so this is a pre-registered CONFIRMATION on overlapping history, not a fresh out-of-sample test.
universe: 8 liquid US ETFs spanning equity, long bonds, gold, short bonds, T-bills: SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, TLT, GLD, SHY, BIL (all with full cached daily history in data/deep + data/)

params.at_trade_event_also_trim: any symbol above max_weight at that open

entry_rule: Day 0 open: buy every symbol to target_weight. First trading day of each month at the open: trade every symbol back to target_weight (valuation at that open).
exit_rule: No discretionary exits. Daily close check: any symbol whose weight > max_weight is trimmed to target_weight at the next open; at that trade event any other symbol above max_weight at the same open is trimmed too (no post-trade weight > 12%).

amendments.change: CAP_DRIFT_GUARD also trims any symbol above max_weight at the open of a trade event
amendments.reason: first run showed a post-trade weight of 12.22% (an untraded name gapped above the cap at the trim open). Cap-compliance fix only; acceptance criteria, universe, weights, windows and datasets unchanged. First-run C1/C2: committed -0.2054 FAIL / 0.0926<=0.1898 PASS; extended_5y -0.2857 FAIL / 0.1848<=0.2538 PASS.

signal_bar: t-1 close (calendar/drift rule only; no price-based signal)
sizing: Equal weight 11.4% per ETF (= 12% ETF hard cap x 0.95 live buffer, as in portfolio_manager.compute_core_orders) => 91.2% invested, 8.8% cash earning 0%. Fractional shares.
friction_source: scripts/backtest/friction.py load_friction('portfolio_1') at run time (floored at 5 bps cost + 5 bps slippage, per side, on traded notional).
benchmark: SPY buy & hold, 100% invested from day 0 open, identical friction on the entry trade
n_trials_note: Zero fitted parameters (weights are fixed by the cap, rebalance is calendar). DSR therefore uses N=1 (DSR == PSR vs 0). This understates multiple-testing risk to the extent the basket choice was informed by prior studies (see prior_knowledge_disclosure).

evaluation.window_layout: non-overlapping 63-bar windows aligned to the most recent bar; leftover oldest bars excluded from window stats but included in full-span stats

datasets.note: Committed caches: data/deep (fetch_deep_history, split-adjusted IEX) spliced forward with morning-research caches in data/.
Gitignored local 5y cache (fetch_deep_history --years 5); covers the 2022 bond+equity bear. Evaluated when present.

C1_sharpe_vs_spy.metric: mean of per-window annualized Sharpe (core) minus mean of per-window annualized Sharpe (SPY)

C2_drawdown_vs_spy.metric: max drawdown of the full-span core equity path vs SPY's full-span max drawdown

C3_live_tracking_error.metric: annualized std of (live core-sleeve daily return - this spec's model daily return)

acceptance.robustness_rule: C1 and C2 must PASS on EVERY evaluated dataset with >= min_windows windows; a dataset with fewer windows is INSUFFICIENT_DATA and cannot produce a PASS.

known_biases: Price-only bars (split-adjusted, NOT dividend-adjusted): distributions are excluded. The core's income-heavy sleeve (TLT, SHY, BIL) is understated more than SPY, so this test is biased AGAINST the core.
IEX-feed closes (free tier) differ slightly from consolidated closes; thin ETFs (BIL, SHY) occasionally miss IEX bars and those dates are dropped from the common axis.
